title: Knafeh Nabulsi
description: A traditional dish from Palestine, centered on phyllo pastry, mozzarella, pistachio. A measured home-kitchen version organized by cooking step. Knafeh Nabulsi-inspired dessert with phyllo and mozzarella instead of traditional kataifi and Nabulsi cheese, both absent from the catalog.

steps.instruction: Shred phyllo and arrange it over the buttered pan around a layer of cheese; this replaces unavailable kataifi pastry.
Roast in a preheated 190°C oven for about 28 minutes until nicely browned and fully cooked; turn once if needed.
Simmer the liquid and flavorings uncovered for about 12 minutes until reduced and concentrated.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
